questions.prompt: Which clip has more city lights?

questions.prompt: Which clip is scanning warmer water?

questions.prompt: Which clip has more desert dust in the air?

questions.prompt: In which clip is the band of hottest water further north? (Listen to the slow, high bell.)

questions.prompt: Which clip has more smoke from fires? (Listen for the low drone.)
